Bundled renderer dependencies / 随包渲染依赖

- PixiJS 6.5.10 (MIT; Copyright (c) 2013-2017 Mathew Groves, Chad Engler)
  https://github.com/pixijs/pixijs
  Full license: pixi-LICENSE.txt
- pixi-live2d-display 0.4.0 (MIT; Copyright (c) 2020 Guan)
  https://github.com/guansss/pixi-live2d-display
  Full license: pixi-live2d-display-LICENSE
- Live2D Cubism Core for Web (Live2D Proprietary Software License)
  https://www.live2d.com/eula/live2d-proprietary-software-license-agreement_en.html
- Legacy Live2D Cubism 2 WebGL runtime (applicable Live2D SDK/runtime terms)
  https://www.live2d.com/eula/

The Live2D runtimes are used only to render user-selected local models. Memo
Superform does not bundle any character model. See ../../THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md
in a source checkout, or THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md beside packaged documentation,
for the complete attribution boundary.
